challenges.title: Build an AI-Powered Chat Interface
description: Build a functional chat interface that communicates with an AI API (use any available: OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama for local models, or a mock/simulated backend).
User Story: I can type a message and send it to an AI assistant that responds.
User Story: The chat displays a conversation history with clear visual distinction between user and assistant messages.
User Story: I can see a loading/typing indicator while waiting for the AI response.
User Story: I can clear the conversation and start fresh.
Bonus User Story: I can configure a system prompt that sets the assistant's personality/role.
Remember to use Read-Search-Ask if you get stuck.

challenges.title: Build a Semantic Search Engine
description: Build a client-side semantic search application that searches a dataset using cosine similarity on pre-computed (or simplified) embeddings.
User Story: I can enter a search query and get results ranked by semantic relevance (not just keyword matching).
User Story: I can see a similarity score next to each result.
User Story: I can search over a dataset of at least 20 items (book descriptions, article summaries, code snippets, etc.).
Hint: For this project, you may use a simplified TF-IDF representation as your 'embedding' if a real embedding API is not available.
Remember to use Read-Search-Ask if you get stuck.
